chunks.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
chunks.title: Q2 Translation Between Representations (TBR) — 12 points
chunks.content: AP Physics C: Mechanics FRQ 2 is Translation Between Representations (TBR), 12 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The TBR task requires moving among words, equations, graphs, diagrams, and data consistently. Q2 topic: energy with a spring (elastic PE, work–energy theorem, force vs. position). Points reward: correct free-body/energy diagrams, correct (often calculus-based) equations, correctly labeled graphs (e.g., force vs. position where area = work), and quantitative results consistent across representations. Common failure: wrong graph shape or unlabeled axes; equation inconsistent with the diagram; not connecting the area under a force–position graph to work/energy.

chunks.content: Q2 (TBR) scored 8/12 — earned most representation points but lost several, commonly a graph feature or an equation inconsistent with the diagram/area interpretation. Illustrates a strong response with a couple of translation slips.

chunks.content: Q2 (TBR) scored 3/12 — earned only a few sub-points, losing most of the graph/equation translation and the consistent quantitative results. Illustrates a response that cannot keep representations consistent.
